system.description: Spend 50 MP to create a fourth Phantasm outside the three-Phantasm limit. Only one at a time, and if you have four Phantasms one must be it. It takes its own turn with a single action, before or after yours, for 3 turns, then shatters; it has your Hit Points; enemies can target it and your allies cannot; and no Skill or Command spell may use it. Its attack deals (HR + 14), rising to (HR + 18) at 20+ and (HR + 20) at 40+, at your equipped weapon's range. Choose an essence at each casting to fix its damage type — physical, light or dark. Its damage ignores Immunities and Resistances, as printed.
